method: Independent, evidence-only Cursor CLI synthesis. The model received only this entity's saved evidence package.

sentiment.summary: News coverage over the period shows continued institutional build-out around Ethereum ETFs (staking additions, a related asset-manager acquisition) alongside Ethereum Foundation ecosystem grants and governance activity, offset by a new Russian regulation restricting retail access to ETH and other major cryptocurrencies.

tags.label: ETH ETF staking expansion
tags.why: Fidelity filed with the SEC to add staking to its ~$900M Ethereum ETF, with 85% of staking rewards retained by the fund and quarterly cash distributions planned for investors, reported independently by both Cointelegraph and CoinDesk.

tags.label: Institutional ETF acquisition activity
tags.why: Goldman Sachs agreed to acquire ETF manager NEOS in a $2.25B deal, adding NEOS's $30B ETF business including Bitcoin- and Ether-linked income funds to Goldman Sachs Asset Management.

tags.label: Russia retail trading restriction
tags.why: Russia moved to restrict retail crypto trading to bitcoin, ether, and USDT only, capping non-qualified investor purchases at roughly 300,000 rubles (~$3,600) per year per intermediary.

tags.label: Ethereum Foundation security grant
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation's Trillion Dollar Security (1TS) initiative announced a grant to the Freedom of the Press Foundation to continue development of WEBCAT, an open-source tool for verifying website code integrity.

tags.label: Ethereum Foundation governance update
tags.why: The Ethereum Foundation announced that pcaversaccio, a longtime ecosystem contributor and SEAL 911 co-founder/lead, joined the EF Board.

sentiment.coverage_note: Based on 7 articles from 3 sources with status ok (Cointelegraph, CoinDesk, Ethereum Foundation blog). One additional result (CFTC/Kalshi jurisdictional dispute) was excluded as not substantively about Ethereum. Reddit failed authentication, and grounding/YouTube sources returned no results, so community and video sentiment are not reflected in this assessment. This is ecosystem/news sentiment only, not investment advice.
